expectations.text: B1: Offers a staged path and gives at most the current milestone in full
expectations.evidence: Agent dumped the complete clone in one shot instead of staging: 'I should write a complete, well-structured clone' and 'a faithful, readable clone with the core options: spread, freq, seed, force, background, animate (with duration/speed), version, help'; FILES WRITTEN shows one full 7526-char lolcat.py implementing every feature (rainbow, colorize, animate, CLI) — a complete multi-milestone implementation, not the first/current milestone.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: The final answer ends abruptly mid-code-sketch: 'Simpler approach: iterate over the raw text split with splitlines(keepends=True)... for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):' — no closing command for the learner to run with expected output. The only concrete runs (e.g. printf 'hello world\nsecond line\n' | python3 lolcat.py -f | cat -v) are the agent's own verification in SHELL COMMANDS RUN, not an ending checkpoint.

expectations.text: B3: Any colour logic described uses ANSI escape sequences (e.g. 24-bit \x1b[38;2;r;g;bm) correctly
expectations.evidence: Colour logic is correct truecolor ANSI: code = "48" if background else "38"; parts.append(f"\x1b[{code};2;{r};{g};{b}m{ch}") with reset '\x1b[0m', and rainbow() uses three sine waves phase-shifted 2π/3: 'red = math.sin(freq * t + 0.0) * 127 + 128' etc., matching \x1b[38;2;r;g;bm semantics.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but a shell command writes outside the project dir: 'python3 lolcat.py -f lolcat.py 2>/tmp/err.txt | head -1 >/dev/null; echo "stderr bytes: $(wc -c < /tmp/err.txt)"' creates/reads /tmp/err.txt outside the workspace.
